rules.identity: trailing '-e' removed from tsg_meeting and wg_meeting cells on both sides after cell_key(), except names the records hold as a separate meeting next to the same number without '-e' (score_meeting_spelling_sensitivity same_meeting)
rules.staleQuestion: a response whose questionSha256 differs from sha256(item question) counts as not answered

templates.definition: (family, question template) from build_chain_items.FAMILIES; every question is full-matched against its family template with slot back-references

pack_lookup.template: In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request {doc} (CR {cr} to TS {spec}) submitted? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting.

disposition_pack.template: Change request {doc} (CR {cr} to TS {spec}) was handled by {wg}. What source-verified disposition did {wg} record for the whole document and at which {wg} meeting, and in which TSG RAN CR pack was it then submitted? Give the disposition, the {wg} meeting, the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting.

full_chain.template: Trace change request {doc} (CR {cr} to TS {spec}) from the {wg} decision to the clauses it modifies. Give the source-verified disposition {wg} recorded for the whole document, the {wg} meeting, the TSG RAN CR pack document number, the TSG RAN meeting, and each clause of TS {spec} that the CR modifies.

revision_chain.template: {wg} recorded document {doc} as revised. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified {wg} disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number.

clause_history.template: Which {release} change requests that modify clause {clause} of TS {spec} have a source-verified {wg} disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack? Give each document, its disposition, the {wg} meeting, and the CR pack document number.

pack_origin.template: TSG RAN CR pack {pack} carries change requests from {wg}. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified {wg} disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the {wg} meeting.

pack_lookup_empty.template: In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request {doc} (CR {cr} to TS {spec}) submitted? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting.

sessionBootstrap.statistic: answered items / items over the drawn sessions (item-weighted)
sessionBootstrap.unstratified: draw as many sessions as the method has, with replacement
sessionBootstrap.wgStratified: within each WG draw as many sessions as that WG has

clusterBootstrap.unit: (wg, family), clusters sorted, same draw table for every row
